service.ur: خلاف ورزی کرنے والوں کے لیے روانگی کا اجازت نامہ

about: Get a permit to leave the UAE after paying fines for overstaying.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For people with fines; fines must be paid first
If a passport is lost, a police report and a consulate travel pass may be used first
documents: Travel ticket with a departure date within 7 days of the permit
fees: Late fine 50 AED a day from the 8th day after the permit expires or is cancelled
timing: Leave within 7 days of issue or the permit must be cancelled
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
